thread:
anya (PM): Quick sync: two large customers want incremental structured streaming + clear tool-invoke contract. Need a concrete MVP.

sam (eng): TL;DR: pick envelope per delta over SSE for MVP. Simpler infra and works for mobile.

luca (eng-rt): Envelope fields: type, delta_type, seq, more, content_type, payload. Client reassembles payload until more:false.

marie (research): Finish reasons proposed: stop, function_call, function_stream, cancel, timeout, incomplete, fallback. Function_stream signals args are still streaming.

nora (devex): SDKs should expose events: onDelta, onStructuredPartial, onStructuredComplete, onFunctionReady, onFinish. Provide reassembly helper and autoInvokeFunctions opt-in.

sam (eng): Telemetry gates: reassembly_fail_rate and unverified_invocations. Canary rollback if reassembly_fail_rate > 0.2%.

anya (PM): MVP must-haves: envelope schema v1 doc, JS+Python helpers, SSE runtime endpoint, audit + telemetry, and 2 pilot customers. WS multiplexing is SHOULD.

luca (eng-rt): Example envelope: {"t":"delta","dt":"struct","seq":1,"more":true,"ct":"application/json","p":"{\"name\":\"A\"}"} then more:false final chunk.

marie (research): Edge-case: function args as binary => include encoding and base64 chunks. Security: require org opt-in for auto-invoke; add audit logs with payload hash.

nora (devex): UX: show partial card but mark unverified until reassembled_verified. Confirm before invoking unless org set autoInvoke.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for feature/streaming-struct-mvp at 2025-03-11T12:00:00Z :rocket:

anya (PM): Action items: Sam/Luca draft runtime contract by Friday; Nora stub SDKs; Marie write finish_reason table. Sync next Tue.
